title: Start here
summary: Configure Base, fund a test wallet, send one transaction, and then choose only the SDKs your product needs.

links.description: Orient your team to Base's current chain model and first-party product primitives.
Configure Base mainnet or Sepolia with the correct chain ID, RPC endpoint, and explorer.
Acquire or bridge mainnet funds and get Base Sepolia ETH or USDC for testing.
Send a first typed Base transaction with Viem before adding a larger application stack.
Choose the maintained first-party entry point for RPC, verification, local tooling, or migrated products.
